scenarios.description: Withdraw both the independent effect premise and the stronger mechanism premise. This tests loss of support, without asserting that no effect occurs.
Assume the exact effect claim false while retaining its adopted positive routes. This is stronger than a failed individual input or an insensitive null study.
Replace the perturbation premise with its negation while keeping independent effect support. No alternative mechanism is thereby identified.
Assume an overriding professional responsibility defeats the application of achievable-benefit reasoning to this professional aim. This supposes a defeater, not an established ethical finding.

undercutters.text: In this application, the reason supplied by achievable benefit is outweighed by a relevant professional responsibility, defeating the inference to a legitimate professional aim.

scenarios.description: Withdraw the intrinsic functional-value premise. This tests which conclusions need that value without denying the empirical improving response.
Withdraw the delivery principle while retaining the assessment and effect claims. A justified aim and a working assessment do not supply that missing normative commitment.

Suppose a substantive practical objection defeats the general use of the delivery principle here. A case in which the existing warranted condition is unmet would not by itself establish this defeater.

undercutters.text: The inference from assessment and the delivery principle to the proposed general application strategy is defeated by an overriding practical objection to that use of the principle.

scenarios.description: Withdraw the broader-effect, predominance and chiropractic-specific likelihood claims. The scoped functional benefit and application strategy must remain independently supported.
